notes.png_results: basic-shapes (artboard at 100,100, PNG 900x640): rendered star-half-opacity, boolean-union, group-background, multiply-overlay, layer-blur, (mask-ellipse hidden source, absent); refused by composite: vector_stroke_not_rendered 3, paint_gradient 1, image_paint_unresolved 1, text_to_image_conversion 1. Probe colours at node boxes within 1/255 of the PNG (asserted <= 4); nothing composited just outside the union and star boxes; >= 97 % of opaque pixels outside the multiply region within 8/255 (measured 95.9 % including the multiply region, which differs by the frame fill, see below). prototype-pages: the three animated-orb ellipses render at exact PNG positions (frame origins 140/540/940,170): centre colour <= 4/255, left/right edge pixels empty 3 px outside and painted 3 px inside, in the render and in the PNGs. components-autolayout: nothing drawable (instances not composited, text-only groups need prepared text): rendered 0, reason pinned
notes.residual_diffs: multiply-overlay beyond group-background: PNG = overlay colour x frame fill (245,247,252) (Figma multiplies with the frame fill); Folio artboards carry no fill and composite draws none, so our pixel is the plain overlay colour; test asserts the multiplied expectation within 2/255. layer-blur renders only because the raster records are passed (without them the blur is skipped silently by composite, so the harness passes them)
